purpose: Initial English level estimate for Spanish-speaking learners. Not an official certification.
design_basis: Original questions aligned with CEFR-oriented task types from Cambridge English and British Council references. They are not copied exam questions.

items.question: She ___ from Spain.
items.explanation_es: Con she usamos el verbo to be en tercera persona: is.

items.question: I ___ coffee every morning.
items.explanation_es: Con I, el presente simple usa la forma base: drink.

items.question: Choose the correct word: A book is usually on a ___.
Yesterday, we ___ to the cinema.
items.explanation_es: Yesterday indica pasado simple; el pasado de go es went.

items.question: I have lived here ___ 2023.
items.explanation_es: Since se usa con el momento de inicio; for se usa con duración.

items.question: If I ___ more time, I would travel more.
items.explanation_es: La segunda condicional usa pasado simple después de if: if I had.

items.question: I wish I ___ speak French better.
items.explanation_es: I wish I could expresa un deseo sobre una habilidad actual.

items.question: Choose the closest meaning of 'reliable'.
items.explanation_es: Reliable significa fiable o digno de confianza.

items.question: Hardly ___ the film started when the lights went out.
items.explanation_es: Con hardly al inicio se usa inversión: Hardly had the film started.

items.question: I'd rather you ___ me tomorrow.
items.explanation_es: I'd rather + sujeto + pasado simple expresa preferencia sobre otra persona.

items.question: The new policy is intended to ___ waste.

scoring.note: The result is an initial estimate only. Later exercises and conversation evidence can update it.
